If you've ever wondered why you're getting matched with what seems like toxic players every game (or kind, cooperative players), there's likely a reason behind it. And it's numerical. This number (in conjunction with your MMR) is what determines who you get matched with.

And it's possible to see what your number is (and thereby hopefully improve it).

  1. At the Main Menu, open up console. (If you haven't enabled console to be opened, go into option and enable console and set a key you'll remember (but that won't get hit mid-game).

  2. Type into console developer 1 -A small popup regarding "spew threshhold" should show up.

  3. Type dota_game_account_debug -A long list with all of your accounts information should pop up.

  4. Scroll down to player_behavior_score_last_report

The closer that number is to 10,000, the higher rated you are by other players in your games. This takes into account the amount of commends, reports, mutes, etc. that you receive on a daily basis.
